data.description:
## Context
Codex does not expose the project rebar skills through its documented user-level discovery location. Existing symlinks are under ~/.codex/skills, while the current Codex manual specifies ~/.agents/skills.

## Plan
- Create ~/.agents/skills if absent.
- Add symlinks for each examples/agent-skills/rebar-* directory.
- Preserve existing ~/.codex/skills links for compatibility.
- Verify every link resolves and contains SKILL.md.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ~/.agents/skills contains rebar-brainstorm, rebar-debug, rebar-implement, and rebar-janitor symlinks.
- [ ] Each link targets this checkout under examples/agent-skills and resolves to a SKILL.md.
- [ ] No repository files are modified.
data.title: Fix user-level Codex discovery for project rebar skills
